tool.name: Promoter Motif Scanner
tool.description: scan for -35 and -10 sigma70 motif candidates
tool.command: #set $reverse_arg = "--scan-reverse-complement" if str($scan_reverse_complement) == "true" else "" #set $minus35_meme_arg = "--minus35-meme '%s'" % $minus35_meme if str($minus35_meme) not in ["", "None"] else "" #set $minus10_meme_arg = "--minus10-meme '%s'" % $minus10_meme if str($minus10_meme) not in ["", "None"] else "" #set $meme_file_arg = "--meme-file '%s'" % $meme_file if str($meme_file) not in ["", "None"] else "" python '$__tool_directory__/promoter_motif_scanner.py' --input-fasta '$input_fasta' --output-tsv 'motif_hits.tsv' --log 'run_log.txt' --mode '$mode' --minus35-consensus '$minus35_consensus' --minus10-consensus '$minus10_consensus' --fimo-binary '$fimo_binary' $minus35_meme_arg $minus10_meme_arg $meme_file_arg $reverse_arg

param.name: meme_file
param.label: Combined MEME motif file for FIMO mode

param.name: fimo_binary
param.label: FIMO executable
param.help: Only used when Scanner mode is FIMO. Use PATH default when the promoter_tools conda environment is configured in job_conf.yml.

tool.help: Scan promoter sequences for -35 and -10 candidates. Simple mode uses consensus matching or MEME PWM files. FIMO mode requires MEME Suite to be installed.
